prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production transparent sprite atlas for a hand-painted historical maritime RPG. Each pose wholly within its cell, entire head, hands, feet, and sword tip visible. Consistent same adult person, costume, proportions, camera and scale, facing RIGHT with side-three-quarter view. No grid, labels, captions, floor, shadows, backgrounds or lettering. Truly transparent alpha background. Detailed realistic painterly game art, no chibi. Adult rugged brown-haired male admiral with short stubble, dark blue leather tunic, red cloak with gold trim and a round compass medallion, brown belts and boots. Preserve reference face and outfit. Wield one European sword. All 24 poses form four rows: row 1 parry sequence (neutral ready, high guard, blade parry, bracing, relax, neutral); row 2 defensive sequence (guard, low guard, middle guard, stepping back, regain balance, neutral); row 3 hit sequence (flinch, recoil, clutch side, stumble backward, recover, neutral); row 4 EXACTLY: neutral standing sword low; command with raised free hand; kneeling on one knee; collapsing low; lying flat on back side view horizontal full body; rising to kneel. Last-but-one figure MUST be truly prone and horizontal, height less than one third its width. No blood or injuries.
